introduction: Florida Reemployment Assistance provides temporary benefits to qualifying workers. File through Reconnect and follow the ongoing payment-request instructions after the initial application.
description: Florida Reemployment Assistance provides temporary benefits to qualifying workers. File through Reconnect and follow the ongoing payment-request instructions after the initial

sections.who: FloridaCommerce reviews past wages, the circumstances of job loss and continuing eligibility. Being out of work is not itself an approval; ability and availability for work are assessed.
sections.get: Approved claimants receive temporary benefit payments. A wage or monetary determination is only one part of the claim review.
sections.docs:

  • Employer names, contact details, dates worked, earnings and separation reasons for the past 18 months.
  • Applicable military, federal-employment or work-authorization records.
sections.apply:
1. Access Reconnect

    Start from FloridaCommerce’s application page and complete the identity and login process.

  2. File the claim

    Report all requested employment history, not just the most recent job. Save the confirmation.

  3. Request benefits

    Review your monetary determination, respond to fact-finding and request benefits every two weeks. Follow the work-search and workforce-registration instructions applicable to your claim.
sections.after: Check the Reconnect Dashboard for messages and record each payment request. Correct missing wages through the review process identified in the determination.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Apply for benefits, Claimant FAQ. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is filing the initial application enough?
No. FloridaCommerce instructs claimants to request benefits every two weeks and satisfy ongoing requirements.
Can I get help without my own computer?
The agency lists local CareerSource centers as an application route; call ahead about assistance.
Yes. Florida requests employment information for the preceding 18 months.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
